item.title: Trump vows to accept midterm results, work with Democrats
item.description: If the projections hold, the second half of Trump's term will look very different. CNN said a Democratic House would end the Republican stranglehold on Washington and set up two years of confrontation with the president. For now, Trump's message is that he will cooperate. "We'll probably work something out," he said.

item.title: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island as Trump downplays war
item.description: Oil rose in early Asian trade on Tuesday after the report, CNBC reported, citing Reuters. The gain followed a drop of more than 7% in Brent on Monday as hopes for diplomacy grew. "Just when markets were starting to price in a more diplomatic path, this reminder of ongoing military activity has flipped the tone," said Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade.
